summary.description: One or two sentences on what changed or why it stopped.

commit_message.description: Conventional one-line subject, optional body. No AI attribution.

pr_body.description: Markdown: what changed and how you verified it. No attribution lines, no 'Generated with' footer, no 'Closes #N' (the workflow adds it).

split_suggestion.description: When too_big or blocked: how to split or what is needed.

found_issues.description: Real bugs or doc gaps you noticed but did not fix because they are out of scope. Only things you verified in the code.

title.description: Specific and short, like an issue title.

body.description: Markdown: what is wrong, evidence with file:line, and how to verify a fix.
